hypothesis: A detached physics prefix is logically independent but often immediately replaces its source. Share immutable cache storage until either lineage needs to mutate it. Source release then transfers ownership without copying geometry, frames, histories or query buffers. Every write still isolates live lineages before mutation; cached reads never clone.

protocol.hypothesis: Detach commonly precedes release of the source lineage. Sharing an immutable cache until mutation avoids eager copying and preserves independent cache/work behavior when both lineages remain live.

engineRegressionGuard.purpose: The combined panel has few detach calls. Check no detected regression; do not claim an engine-panel speedup without separate confirmation.

protocol.adoption: Require a fresh KEEP confirmation on the standalone 150k automatic workload, no detected engine-panel or standalone 750k regression, exact structural gates and reported memory diagnostics. This targets native-engine prefix ownership, not solver arithmetic. Fixed counts; no extensions of inconclusive runs.

detachmentDiagnostic.purpose: Attribute copying cost and expose deferred cost while both lineages remain live; not a promotion gate.

primaryInterpretation: Before timing the frozen copy-on-write candidate, declared standalone automatic compilation as primary because prefix detachment is frequent there and rare in the broad engine panel. Engine and 750k runs are prespecified regression guards, not additional speedup claims. Do not infer a solver arithmetic speedup from the compiler result.

postRegistrationStepping.description: Exploratory post-registration stepping diagnostic, fixed alternating pairs after three warmups in one process. Not a promotion gate.

detachmentDiagnostic.description: Diagnostic only: twenty detach cycles per committed track. Registration and initial replay occur outside timing. Release-source transfers ownership; retained-source-first-write keeps the source alive and evicts a frame in each detached cache before releasing it, including the deferred copy cost. No solver steps are timed. Twelve alternating pairs after three warmups in one process; not a promotion confirmation.

memoryDiagnostic.description: WASM linear-memory high-water size after each complete workload in a fresh instance; not live allocations or process RSS.

postMeasurementComments.description: Two comment corrections after performance measurement: cache clones clear queries, and dropping a holder releases its cache ownership. No executable source change. Repackaging must remain byte-identical to the frozen measured WASM.

manifest.note: Computed-cache copies and collision observations only. Cached contact positions are read without stepping or replay. Final judging uses the unchanged benchmark engine.

accepted.decision: Keep after fresh primary automatic confirmation, no detected engine-panel or larger-budget regression, memory diagnostics and exact structural gates. Solver equations and frame storage are unchanged.

limitations: Bootstrap support is not a posterior or an anytime-valid stopping rule.
The standalone 150k automatic case has fresh confirmation. The larger-budget case and broad engine panel are regression checks, not independently confirmed speedup headlines.
Stepping and detachment diagnostics use alternating pairs in one process; they are not fresh-process promotion confirmations.
The copy cost is deferred when both lineages remain live. The retained-source detachment diagnostic includes that first-write cost.
These results concern fixed workloads on this machine, not unseen songs or hardware.
